1.

**Evidence**
Attach a reviewed `openzjs-support.json` if available, and cropped screenshots.
Use non-sensitive reproduction documents. Do not attach HP firmware, signing
keys, spool files, private documents, registry exports or recovery backups.
Describe any signing/security configuration changes; do not make new changes
merely to file this report.
